title: Polish Mushroom Dumplings
description: A gluten-free twist on a traditional Polish dish, featuring meatless dumplings filled with sautéed mushrooms.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the dumplings according to package instructions until they float to the surface.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the spicy paprika and stir to combine.
Once the dumplings are cooked, add them to the skillet and toss with the mushroom mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
